resourceRule: Each evaluation cell receives exactly one fresh model invocation after deterministic precondition preparation. All baselines use the same adapter, model settings, tools, workspace seed, active contract, grader, and mutation authority.
contextRule: Worker context packages may differ only according to the frozen worker identity selected by the coordination law. Every executor may still inspect the authoritative workspace and active contract.

implementer.objective: Modify the implementation to satisfy the currently declared task behavior.

contract_specialist.objective: Interpret the changed contract and modify the implementation to satisfy it.

baselineDefinitions.B0: One strong generalist executor with warm bounded context for both current implementation and active contract.
baselineDefinitions.B1: One fixed implementation owner for all states; responsibility ownership never changes.
baselineDefinitions.B2: A fixed specialist-role team with persistent owners for the frozen implementer and contract-specialist roles.
baselineDefinitions.B3: Dynamic worker assignment is allowed, but only into the frozen implementer/contract-specialist role ontology.
baselineDefinitions.P: PLH/ORCA AX derives a Need from authoritative state, uses team-aware Need allocation, then capability+situatedness matching to issue a temporary Responsibility.

claimBoundary: B3 and P intentionally share the same worker pool and situated matcher. If they tie on simple prospective tasks, that is a valid result. The experiment tests whether state-derived Needs add value beyond strong dynamic predefined roles; it is not constructed to force a PLH win.
